hazards.evidence: Wooden handrail is mounted only on the right wall; the left side of the staircase has no rail, so support is available on one side only.
The wall-mounted wooden rail on the right appears to run only the upper portion of the flight and does not continue to the lowest steps; continuity/grasp along the full run is limited.
Stairwell is dim and unevenly lit; the lower steps and left side are in deep shadow with no visible dedicated stair light.
Patterned/worn carpet runner with no contrasting nosing makes tread edges blend together, and the covering looks loose/uneven on the mid-flight treads.
A light-colored cord/wire runs along the floor at the lower-left base of the stairs, across the approach path.
